text:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a noisy eviction loop in ap-southeast1a where tiny GPU pods keep bouncing between racks. Cost + spot churn spiking.
maria: any short logs or events?
alex: pasted a short events dump below

```
Normal  PodScheduled    pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9   Successfully assigned ns/tiny-trainer-7f5b9 to rack-az3-node-12
Warning FailedScheduling  pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9  2/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had taint {gpu-preempt=true:PreferNoSchedule}, 1 node(s) had insufficient resources.
Normal  Killing         pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9   Stopping container
```
ben: hmm looks like scheduler rebalancer + taint oscillation. rebalancer keeps draining underfilled racks to defrag, but NIC/conntrack pressure causes transient capacity loss so pods get rescheduled elsewhere — ping-pong.
devon: this matches the coldstart "pinball" we've measured: an eviction leads to a new warmup, causing more preemptions in the origin rack.
alex: cost impact: ap-southeast1 spot churn doubled last 3 hours — estimate ~$1.4k extra.
lee: can we throttle defrag frequency? current rebalancer interval is 5m.
maria: i proposed raising it to 20m in the last rollout but it got reverted. we also have lease timeouts at 15s which feels aggressive.
ben: quick mitigation options:
- bump rebalancer interval to 20m
- increase lease/handshake timeout to 60s
- exclude pods with tiny-gpu label from active rebalancing
- add temporary node-anti-affinity override for tiny workloads
alex: tried a warmpool bump earlier (2->5) for that AZ, didn't fully stop oscillation.
sre-bot: ALERT: evictions ap-southeast1a > 50 in 30m. Pager duty sent to oncall.
maria: patch sketch I can apply now:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  rebalancer.interval: "20m"
  lease.timeout: "60s"
  rebalancer.exclude-labels: "tiny-gpu"
```
ben: also recommend scheduler scoring tweak: lower pack score for small pods so they don't force aggressive binpack moves.
devon: we should measure tail latency too — warmpool changes might increase start latency but reduce churn cost.
lee: temporary manual step: add taint `no-rebalance=true:NoSchedule` to rack-az3 nodes while we validate config.
alex: I'll stand up the canary with the config map in ap-southeast1a and watch evictions for 1h.
maria: i'll own the rollout. will post prometheus scrape ids and query next.
ben: long-term: need a smarter coalescer that avoids moving pods when network metrics (conntrack, tx) are high.
alex: assigning follow-ups to @maria and @ben. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created (eviction-wave ap-southeast1a)."
